scope: Supplementary mathematical coverage; component proofs are distinguished from exact combined statements.

rows.title: Pure-state loss distributions
rows.scope: The actual phase-paired corrected estimator and its loss distributions.

rows.title: Bounded martingale sums
rows.scope: Strong law and logarithmic rates for bounded martingale differences, extended coordinatewise.

rows.title: Freezing and averaging
rows.scope: The refresh/freezing identities and convergence are explicit. Averaging also uses Mathlib Cesaro results; there is no single combined endpoint named after the printed lemma.

rows.title: Direct adaptive asymptotic normality
rows.scope: Bounded Euclidean martingale differences with the stated conditional covariance limit, including positive-semidefinite limits.

rows.title: Projection and normalization bounds
rows.scope: Tangent/retraction identities and constants are retained. The nearest-projector expansion is proved for the implemented deterministic nearestVector selection, including ties; the printed arbitrary nearest-projector selection is broader.

rows.title: Transfer to smooth coordinates
rows.scope: The transfer endpoints assume almost-sure consistency, whereas the standalone printed lemma assumes convergence in probability. Main algorithm endpoints prove almost-sure consistency. Coordinate identities and covariance transformation are retained.

rows.title: Reference basis construction
rows.scope: The concrete finite randomized-projective reference, complete law, positivity, identification and Fisher-symmetry construction.

rows.title: Multinomial score covariance
rows.scope: The finite categorical score/covariance cancellation identity.

rows.title: Fitted-weight cancellation
rows.scope: The implemented adaptive GeneralPOVM/Algorithm 3 case is proved. The printed generic predictable rotated-POVM process with an arbitrary qualifying preliminary fit, including the generic ambient inverse-operator limit, has no exactly matching standalone endpoint.

rows.title: Bounded martingale moments
rows.scope: Gaussian-type tails and all positive real moments for bounded centered Euclidean martingale differences.

rows.title: Mixed-qubit moment bounds
rows.scope: Inverse-Gram and actual raw/physical mixed-estimator moments of all positive real orders; fourth-moment endpoints are also retained.

rows.title: Pure-state moment bounds
rows.scope: All integer moment orders for the actual estimators; RealMomentBounds provides the positive-real-order interpolation used with them.

rows.title: Identification, positivity and Fisher symmetry
rows.scope: The finite covariance-example measurement, positivity and exact minimum reference mass, with its information and identifying results.

rows.title: Tangent Gram and noise coefficients
rows.scope: Finite frame/noise sums and resulting aligned covariance coefficients.
